title: Find your room
intro: Search a building or room, or use your student ID and private check-in code to find your assigned rooms.
notice: November 14, 2026 · Demo preview. Room assignments, entrances and indoor routes below are not event-day directions. Confirm your destination with BMT staff.
helpText: Need a step-free route or cannot find your room? Ask the BMT help desk before setting off. Do not rely on an unverified route for accessibility.

buildings.name: Demo Learning Center
buildings.verificationNote: Fictional building placed near campus only to demonstrate the room finder. This is not Dwinelle Hall, a real floor plan, or a real entrance location.

entrances.name: Demo main entrance
entrances.notes: Illustration only: this sample entrance uses steps.
steps: In this demonstration, start at the entrance marked Main.
Follow the sample lobby sign to the ground-floor corridor.

entrances.name: Demo step-free entrance
entrances.notes: Demonstration of an accessible route, not a verified campus access point.
steps: In this demonstration, use the entrance marked Step-free.
Continue along the level sample corridor; no stairs are shown.

image.alt: Demonstration only: a fictional rectangular ground floor with rooms A101 and A102 on either side of a corridor, a main entrance and a step-free entrance.
image.caption: Illustrative layout only. Not to scale and not a real campus floor plan.

steps: From the sample lobby, take the corridor to the left.
Look for the door labeled A101, marked 1 on the demonstration plan.
Continue along the sample level corridor.
Enter A101 through the marked door on your left.
From the sample lobby, follow the corridor to the right.
Look for A102, marked 2 on the demonstration plan.
Follow the sample level corridor past A101.
Use the door marked A102 on the right.
